settings.content:
GIVE $10 / GET $10

Our Ambassador program is based on a simple, “pay-it-forward” referral system we call Give $10 / Get $10.

You can share your code online or “Shake & Share” a product sample on the court.

Why is this program so great?

Because you make $10 EVERY TIME your friends order 5 Point Zero.

(Not just the first time they order.)

Unlike other companies that make you “apply” to represent their products,

we appreciate all pickleball players who want to share a healthy product with their friends.

Become a “pro-sumer” (making money on products you love and share)

instead of a “consumer” (spending money and earning nothing for your recommendations).

Whether you know 1 other pickleball player or 1,001 — you’re in.

settings.caption: Edward Perez is a 5 Point Zero Ambassador. He is also a World Pickleball Tour professional, plays forthe Chennai Super Kings, and is ranked #71 in the world in men’s singles.
settings.content:
HOW IT WORKS
You choose a referral code.

When your friend makes a 5 Point Zero purchase with your code,

THEY receive a $10 DISCOUNT on their first product order

PLUS every future product order and

YOU receive $10 IN CASH or PRODUCT

CREDIT on their first product order
PLUS every future product order they place.

This customer is CODED to you.

They always save $10.

You always earn $10.

Every product order. Period.

To earn cash instead of product credits,

you just need a PayPal or Venmo account

so we can direct deposit the money you earn from your referrals.
